about.label: About
about.heroHeading: From profile to offer, with AI that adapts to you
about.heroDesc: Open Ai Jobs Search builds your base CV once, then adapts it to every opening. Ranked offers, tailored applications, interview prep and learning plans in one guided flow, from the free plan up.
about.problemP1: Applying for jobs should not be a second job. Tailoring a CV for every opening, writing cover letters, tracking applications and preparing for interviews can burn you out before you land anything.
about.problemP2: Generic templates waste your time, and most AI tools fail when their single provider hits a limit. Your search stops at the worst moment.
about.solutionP1: Everything starts from your profile. You get an ATS-ready base CV, offers ranked by fit, a CV adapted to each offer with a match score, and the cover letter to go with it. Interview prep, Expand and Upskill close the loop.
about.solutionP2: A resilient orchestrator keeps the flow running across multiple AI providers, so a rate limit never stops you. Your data stays encrypted and is never used for training.
about.builtByRole: I built this project end to end: product, backend and frontend. It is open source, so you can explore the code or reach out directly.
about.ctaHeading: Ready to turn your profile into offers?
about.ctaDesc: Start free with weekly credits, no card required. Upgrade to Pro or Max whenever you need more.
